messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment started for release v2025.3 (canary -> 10%). change-window: 14:00-16:00 UTC. runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/4821-Backout+and+Evacuation+Procedures :rocket:

maya: quick sync — who's owning the backout if the canary error rate > 2%? :thinking_face:

samir: i'll be oncall for the window. if error_rate > 2% for 5m or p95 latency > 800ms, we abort and pin to prev-stable. owns: samir (eng-oncall), supports: eli, harper. :white_check_mark:

eli: suggested emergency commands (copy if needed):
```
# pin routing to previous model version
redwoodctl routes update --service api-model --target-version v2025.2 --traffic 100
# drain canary nodes
redwoodctl node drain --pool canary-1
# rollback container image
kubectl set image deploy/api api=registry/redwood/api:v2025.2 -n prod
```

harper: add a note — don't scale to 0 on dedicated pools during rollback; it causes slow warmup. prefer traffic switch + gradual drain. :no_entry_sign:

maya: confirmed. i updated the runbook with specific metric thresholds and the exact commands to run (link above). also added the postmortem checklist items we discussed. thanks @samir for taking point. :pray:

ava: small ops note — metrics to monitor in the first 10m: 1) 5m error rate, 2) p95 latency, 3) cache miss ratio (%), 4) auth failures. if cache_miss rises > 25% concurrently with latency spike, consider toggling prefix cache (see runbook).

samir: putting the live checklist here for quick copy: 1) check canary logs `redwoodctl logs --tail 200 --selector canary=true` 2) run `curl -sS https://status.internal/redwood/health` 3) if anomaly, run pin command (see eli) 4) notify #incidents and set incident severity.

maya: agreed escalation path: s1 -> engage eng-sre + pm; s2 -> eng-oncall only. i've pinned the change window on calendar and DM'd legal for the retention note.

eli: one more: if pin fails due to capacity mismatch, fallback -> route 50% traffic to v2025.2 and 50% to v2025.3 while we investigate, do not fully fail traffic to legacy model unless requested. document this as 'graceful degrade' in runbook.

samir: noted. i'm standby in VC and will post final status here after canary completes first 15m. :phone:

deploy-bot: Canary reached 10% at 14:05 UTC. automated checks: error_rate=0.4%, p95=210ms, cache_miss=3%. No alerts. Will report at +15m. :white_check_mark:
